name: Gearwaterarea Pattern
description: to represent gear types in terms of the water areas where they can be employed to collect aquatic resources
scenarios: in which water areas are 'bottom gillnets' used?
competency_questions: in which water areas are what gear types used? (provided that species caught by geartypes are present in those water areas)
